title: Unlocking Turing Tensor Cores: A Measured Throughput Account of From-Scratch Pre-training on a Single 22G RTX 2080 Ti
abstract: arXiv:2611.05419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The RTX 2080 Ti (TU102) ships full second-generation Tensor Cores in hardware, yet the vendor throttles FP16 matrix multiplication at the driver level, leaving usable tensor throughput well below the hardware peak. turing-unlock lifts this restriction with a kernel module that, before the nvidia driver binds the device, writes the FP16 speed selectors (SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8) and releases the ACR mutex; published measurements report cuBLAS FP16 matmul throughput rising from 55.7 to 91.4 TFLOPS (about 1.6x). On the same 22G 2080 Ti and under the same from-scratch pre-training protocol as the companion memory ledger (five tiers of Chinese encoder-decoder models, 2,451 steps per tier, 16,384 tokens per step, seed 42), we obtain a before/after throughput account: the small tier (75.7M parameters, 512-wide, 8+8 layers, activation checkpointing on) improves in steady-state throughput from 6,480 to 7,246 tok/s (+11.8%) with wall time cut fro

translated_title: 解锁图灵张量核心：在单张22G RTX 2080 Ti上从头预训练的实测吞吐量报告
translated_abstract: RTX 2080 Ti（TU102）在硬件上配备了完整的第二代张量核心，但厂商在驱动层面限制了FP16矩阵乘法的速度，使可用的张量吞吐量远低于硬件峰值。turing-unlock通过一个内核模块解除了这一限制：在nvidia驱动绑定设备之前，写入FP16速度选择器（SS0=0x88888888, SS1=0x8）并释放ACR互斥锁；已发表的测量结果显示，cuBLAS FP16矩阵乘法吞吐量从55.7提升至91.4 TFLOPS（约1.6倍）。在与配套显存账目研究相同的22G 2080 Ti上、遵循相同的从头预训练协议（五个规模的中文编码器-解码器模型，每档2,451步，每步16,384个token，随机种子42），我们获得了开启前后对比的吞吐量报告：小规模档（75.7M参数，512宽，8+8层，开启激活检查点）的稳态吞吐量从6,480提升至7,246 tok/s（+11.8%），墙钟时间缩短……
tldr: 提出turing-unlock内核模块，通过在nvidia驱动绑定设备前写入FP16速度选择器解除RTX 2080 Ti的FP16算力限制，使cuBLAS FP16矩阵乘吞吐量提升约1.6倍，并在单卡从头预训练中实现实测稳态吞吐量提升11.8%。
en_tdlr: The turing-unlock kernel module removes NVIDIA's driver-level FP16 throttle on the RTX 2080 Ti by writing FP16 speed selectors before driver binding, boosting cuBLAS FP16 matmul throughput by ~1.6x and yielding a measured +11.8% steady-state pre-training throughput gain on a single 22G card.
